summary: Implemented the window-title setting; no tests or repository code were run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal and returning True/False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Open point: Console.control() skips output on dumb terminals, so set_window_title returns True there without writing; this mirrors show_cursor but does not fully meet "True means written".
